name: stickers
description: A sticker palette above the prompt: send stickers with a click, a digit or /sticker, and see the stickers Claude sends back.

packDir.title: Sticker pack folder
packDir.description: A folder holding stickers.json and one PNG per sticker (an SVG beside it is optional, for the desktop app). Absolute, ~/, or relative to the working directory. Empty uses the built-in pack.

teachClaude.title: Let Claude send stickers
teachClaude.description: Tell Claude which stickers exist so it can write :sticker:<name>: in a reply, which is drawn as the sticker.
